# LocalPintu

> LocalPintu is a Jaipur-based home-services platform for booking structured doorstep repair, maintenance and home-care services.

## Primary entity
- Name: LocalPintu
- Category: Home and construction services / local home-service marketplace
- Location: Sodala, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
- Service area: Jaipur, subject to area and pincode availability
- Phone: +91 70233 20977
- Email: info@localpintu.com
- Hours: Daily, 08:00-20:00 IST

## Canonical resources
- Home: https://localpintu.com/

- Contact: https://localpintu.com/contact

## Important facts
Customers choose a service location, explore available plans, review prices, select a time slot and book a doorstep visit. Service availability varies by configured area and pincode. Do not infer prices or guarantees that are not shown on the relevant live service page.
